name: Schala — Shadow Weaver

def.notes: Crono Porcelain Hollows that mirror his galaxy; plates not given.

phases.name: Librarian
phases.on_enter: Schala: Stay still, stay beautiful. Sera: You're tired. You can put it down.
phases.on_break: Spills buff pools: red (ATK), blue (MP drain to the stander), gold (a Debt rebate).
phases.notes: Shield 12, Tags [VITREOUS][WARD][TACHYON], Weak [SWORD] (scratch the glass), [ASTRAL] (2.0x, polish). Aim her shuttles back at her. HP windows are not given for Schala; 1.0-0.65, 0.65-0.3, 0.3-0 are an even split.

phases.name: Cat Unraveled
phases.on_enter: Vesper: Schala, are you still reading? The cat: I was reading you. Entry 5-01: He finally looked.
phases.notes: Shield 16, Tags [VITREOUS][MYCELIA][TACHYON][LIGHT], Weak [FERRO] (anchor), [RUIN] (2.6x at Boost Lv3).

phases.name: Shadow Weaver
phases.on_break: The mask falls, she is crying; the Break renders the unified 60 fps gold (Vaelos's dream of one perfect timeline, rejected).
phases.notes: Shield 20 with two Breaks (at 10 plates and at 0): written as shield 10 with refill_once. Tags [NULL][VITREOUS][ASTRAL]. Weak: a hit carrying both [VITREOUS] and [ASTRAL] (the weak list cannot express 'both'; a single-tag hit must not shave).

phases.name: Mercy (conditional)
phases.notes: Shield 0. If Light was kept, there is no combat. Skipped on the Polished route.

options.label: Shatter the perfect window
options.requires: Light: free her; Vesper learns Fractured Lens, Sera's HOLD lengthens, +15 Light, the cathedral fills with air

options.label: Preserve the eternity
options.requires: Dark: Vesper's Prism Guard stores more stacks but never self-shatters, the boss gains +25% shield and skips Phase 4, constant Grief-Resonance hum, +15 Dark

options.label: Weave It Anew
options.requires: align all seven colours using the secret U3 shard, with Crono at 20% showing his galaxy deliberately during the final alignment: +10 Prismatic and the Triple Chrono Prism fragment

notes: Lv 38, HP 86,000. A massive Art Nouveau portrait of herself in the Rose Window with the cat in her lap and a loom. She throws razor filament that refracts white light into coloured stacks. The chrono_prism_fragment drop is the Weave It Anew reward only. On the Polished route the boss gains +25% shield.
